quest_target.mode: context patch only; preserve existing callbacks and nonzero returns; do not publish or install a full integrated global file

guard_dependencies.qualification: Symbol provenance only, not selective integration certification. No whole companion feature import, false-return stubs or weakened guards authorized. Root integration required.

validation.native: Prior exact-target patch apply check and focused review only; no C++ build or native acceptance. Public AA baseline is not an apply or compile target.

runtime_install: Separate private runtime-install-map; publication is not installation. Matching native binding must be built/deployed before helper or hooks activate.
